stories.headline: Meta Contractors Posed as Teens to Prompt Rival Chatbots About Suicide, Sex, and Drugs
stories.dek: Hundreds of contractors working on a project for Meta pretended to be kids in order to see how other chatbots like Gemini and ChatGPT would respond to high-risk subjects, WIRED found.
